description: Quests, dialogue and NPCs in the game's UI, the default (docs/kiln/services/npcs.md): good uses every key in a clean mod with its cook recipe, with what one knowledge check cannot say taken by the engine; bad is what the boot build refuses, what has no form in the game's UI, and the clients rule.

diagnostics.message: no "license": say how others may use the mod (an SPDX expression, e.g. MIT)
no game-data catalog: 7 reference(s) to the game's items, templates, ... were not checked (make one with `kiln catalog`, or pass --catalog)

a conversation names a voice-over from this mod's cooked audio but the mod says "clients": "none": only players with the mod's files hear it; declare "clients": "mod" and side "both", or use a game line's GUID

this mod has a quest in the game's journal (the default), dialogue in the game's NPC menu or an NPC clone but says "clients": "none": a client builds them at boot from the mod's files, so a player without those sees nothing; declare "clients": "mod" and side "both" (servers then refuse players without it). For a mod vanilla clients join, every quest says "journal": "chat" and every dialogue "native": false
npc notemplate: its dialogue is in the game's menu, which belongs to an NPC's template: name one in "template" (or say "native": false on the dialogue)
npc placed: "near": no NPC "nobody" in this mod's quest files ("player", an id of npcs, or a place)
npc vanilla: "roster" needs "clone": the game's own NPCs are in the roster already
npc vanilla: unknown knowledge "nope" (declare it in "knowledge", or use 0x... or npc:<debugName>.unlock)
npc c: unknown knowledge "nope" (declare it in "knowledge", or use 0x... or npc:<debugName>.unlock)
quest q: a journal entry needs "name"
quest q: a step in the journal needs "text"
quest q: no voice-over "gone" in this mod's assets/cook.json
quest plain: "toast" is a chat line now: the game has no free-text notification. Put it in a step's text or an NPC's reply
quest plain: "reach": "site" needs the step's "site"
quest plain: "near": no NPC "nobody" in this mod's quest files ("player", an id of npcs, or a place)
quest narrow: "near": no NPC "nobody" in this mod's quest files ("player", an id of npcs, or a place)
quest narrow: "talk" opens a chat conversation: the game's menu opens only when a player talks to the NPC. Give the NPC a marker and a hint instead
dialogue d: "start" must name a node (default "start")
no node "gone" in this mod's quest files
dialogue d: no voice-over "gone" in this mod's assets/cook.json
no "license": say how others may use the mod (an SPDX expression, e.g. MIT)
